title: Concept: Dependency installed from a git checkout
description: package.json declares a dependency installed from a git remote rather than the registry, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The recorded version is a commit the registry never vetted, the tarball has no registry integrity value, and the repository can be rewritten after review.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package.json (npm).
risk: The recorded version is a commit the registry never vetted, the tarball has no registry integrity value, and the repository can be rewritten after review.
